spans.s:
सौखशायनिक m. (-कः) One who asks another whether he has slept well
also सौखशायि क ।

सौखसुप्तिक m. (-कः) A bard, a minstrel, one whose duty is to waken the
prince in the morning with music.
 E. सुखसुप्त sleeping pleasantly,
and ठञ् aff.
सौखिक f. (-की) Relating to pleasure; also सौखोय ।

सौख्य n. (-ख्यं) Pleasure, happiness, felicity.
 E. सुख happiness, ष्यञ् aff.
